body.name: Single-conjunction representative transition
body.construction: After deterministic normalization, at layer \(i+1\) and for each block \(T\in\pi_i\), intervened worlds take their intervention constants and natural worlds share one output. If that output is not pinned, branch once on each distinct intervention constant in \(T\) and once on one scanned representative of \(\mathcal D_{i+1}\) outside those constants when such a value exists; reject inconsistent natural pins.
